Title: MSSQL T-SQL miner and Gh0st RAT - domain
Description: Attacker-controlled zone used as the campaign file server, scanner C2 and miner reporter (site.vietnam852.com) and as an FTP staging host (ftp.vietnam852.com). Source: FortiGuard Labs – T-SQL Being Abused to Deliver Malware on Compromised MS SQL Servers https://www.fortinet.com/blog/threat-research/t-sql-being-abused-to-deliver-malware-on-compromised-ms-sql-servers
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and search 90 days of proxy, DNS and firewall logs for connections.
